workflows.name: Structure Acquisition
workflows.description: Download structure by PDB ID or load local molecular file, verify atom loading, and apply standard styling.

steps.name: Resolve PDB Identifier
steps.description: Validate format of 4-character PDB code or AlphaFold ID

steps.name: Fetch Structure
steps.description: Download coordinate file directly from RCSB PDB without collision overwrite

steps.name: Verify Atoms & Chains
steps.description: Ensure non-zero atoms and enumerate loaded chains

steps.name: Apply Visualization
steps.description: Display cartoon representation and color by secondary structure or chain

steps.name: Orient Camera
steps.description: Re-orient viewport along principal inertia axes

validation_criteria.precondition: Valid 4-character PDB ID or accessible local file
validation_criteria.postcondition: Target object exists in PyMOL with count_atoms > 0
validation_criteria.gate: Network fetch must return status == 200 equivalent before subsequent tools execute

workflows.error_recovery: If PDB fetch fails with 404, verify accession spelling. If network timeout occurs, inform user and do not retry invalid ID.
workflows.cancellation_behavior: Delete half-loaded object if user cancels during fetch.
scientific_limitations: PDB coordinates represent crystallographic or cryo-EM models; disordered loops may have missing electron density.
Residue numbering follows author PDB convention and may differ from canonical UniProt sequence numbering.

workflows.name: Structural Inspection
workflows.description: Inspect loaded structures, detailing chains, atom counts, heteroatoms, ligands, secondary structure, and missing features.

steps.name: Enumerate Objects
steps.description: Discover loaded molecular objects in PyMOL session

steps.name: Extract Macro-Statistics
steps.description: Query total atoms, protein/nucleic atoms, solvent, and inorganic ions

steps.name: Identify Chains & Sequences
steps.description: Extract unique chain IDs and polymer residue lengths

steps.name: Detect Ligands & Heteroatoms
steps.description: Identify non-polymer organic ligands and cofactor residues

steps.name: Synthesize Overview
steps.description: Summarize structural topology and report any detectable gaps or missing residues

validation_criteria.precondition: At least one molecular object loaded in PyMOL session
validation_criteria.postcondition: Non-empty summary reporting atom counts, chains, and ligands

workflows.error_recovery: If no structures are loaded, prompt user to download or load a structure first.
scientific_limitations: Inspection is geometric and based on coordinate metadata; does not infer biological activity without experimental assays.

workflows.name: Structure Comparison
workflows.description: Superimpose two protein structures, calculate RMSD, identify divergent regions, and report alignment coverage.

steps.name: Resolve Comparison Targets
steps.description: Identify mobile and reference target objects from session

steps.name: Verify Chain Compatibility
steps.description: Inspect chain identities in both structures

steps.name: Execute Structural Alignment
steps.description: Align mobile onto target using sequence-informed 'align' or structural 'super'

steps.name: Compute Strict C-alpha RMSD
steps.description: Measure coordinate displacement across aligned residue pairs

steps.name: Identify Divergent Loci
steps.description: Locate residues with significant spatial displacement (> threshold)

steps.name: Visualize Superimposition
steps.description: Color structures distinctly to highlight conformational differences

validation_criteria.precondition: At least 2 distinct objects loaded in PyMOL
validation_criteria.postcondition: Valid RMSD floating-point measurement (> 0.0) and aligned atom count > 0

workflows.error_recovery: If sequence-informed 'align' fails due to low sequence homology (<30%), automatically fall back to structure-based 'super'.
workflows.cancellation_behavior: Preserve original coordinates if alignment is cancelled before completion.
scientific_limitations: PyMOL 'align' performs outlier rejection cycles by default; reported post-refinement RMSD reflects the retained core atoms.
Unrefined all-atom or C-alpha RMSD should be reported alongside aligned atom counts for rigorous comparability.

workflows.name: Mutation Neighborhood
workflows.description: Analyze point mutation position, verify wildtype residue, measure spatial contact neighborhood, and visualize local locus.

steps.name: Parse Mutation Notation
steps.description: Extract wildtype residue, sequence position, mutant amino acid, and chain

steps.name: Validate Wildtype in Structure
steps.description: Verify that the amino acid at the specified position matches wildtype

steps.name: Measure Spatial Neighborhood
steps.description: Identify all residues within cutoff distance (default 5.0 Å) of the mutation site

steps.name: Find Geometric Polar Contacts
steps.description: Identify candidate donor/acceptor pairs (distance <= 3.5 Å)

steps.name: Render Visual Highlighting
steps.description: Display mutation site as sticks/spheres with labels and local neighborhood context

steps.name: Orient on Mutation Site
steps.description: Center and zoom viewport onto the mutation locus

validation_criteria.precondition: Target protein loaded in session and residue position exists
validation_criteria.postcondition: Verified wildtype match or explicit discrepancy report, plus contact residue list

workflows.error_recovery: If wildtype amino acid does not match sequence position, report the actual residue found in the PDB rather than failing silently.
scientific_limitations: Distance-based polar contacts (<= 3.5 Å) are geometric donor-acceptor approximations, not confirmed physical hydrogen bonds.
Geometric proximity does NOT establish thermodynamic delta-delta-G or functional pathogenicity without validated biophysical modeling.

workflows.name: Publication Visualization
workflows.description: Prepare publication-grade molecular rendering with publication preset, white background, optimal camera orientation, and export.

steps.name: Assess Structure Focus
steps.description: Inspect loaded objects and active selections

steps.name: Apply Publication Preset
steps.description: Set clean cartoon representation with distinct chain coloring or binding site focus

steps.name: Configure High-Contrast Environment
steps.description: Set background to pure white for journal publication standards

steps.name: Optimize Camera Viewport
steps.description: Orient view along principal axes and apply framing buffer

steps.name: Ray-Trace & Export PNG
steps.description: Render high-resolution figure (1920x1080) with PyMOL ray-tracing engine

steps.name: Export Reproducible Script & Session
steps.description: Save session state (.pse) and reproducible PyMOL command script (.pml)

validation_criteria.precondition: At least one structure loaded in PyMOL session
validation_criteria.postcondition: Exported PNG file exists on disk and is non-empty (>0 bytes)

workflows.error_recovery: If ray-tracing encounters memory or driver limitations, fall back to OpenGL viewport capture (`ray=False`).
workflows.cancellation_behavior: Preserve previous camera view and settings if cancelled.
scientific_limitations: Publication figures represent static molecular models; molecular surfaces are calculated based on chosen solvent probe radius (default 1.4 Å).
